coverage_notes: Exhaustive sweep across eight distinct angles: (1) Analyst/market reports (Gartner Magic Quadrant 2025-2026, Forrester Wave Q2 2025, market-sizing CAGR projections); (2) Official product documentation (Tableau, Metabase, Superset, Hex, Grafana native sources); (3) Competitive analysis/review platforms (G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, StackShare, Modern DataTools); (4) VC/funding databases (Crunchbase, Tracxn, press releases for Tableau/Metabase/Hex Series rounds); (5) Academic HCI/visualization research (IEEE TVCG, ACM CHI/UIST proceedings, arXiv preprints on visual query languages, narrative visualization, interactive analytics); (6) Open-source ecosystem analysis (Apache Superset, Metabase GitHub, community comparisons); (7) Market trends (Modern Data Stack evolution, self-service BI growth, augmented analytics, data democratization, embedded analytics, streaming analytics); (8) UX/design patterns (dashboard design systems, UI component libraries, interaction research). Coverage deduped by URL across all result sets. Prioritized: Gartner/Forrester (T0), official vendor docs (T1), peer-reviewed academic (T1), market reports from established analysts (T2), G2/review aggregates (T2), secondary essays/blogs (T3). Notable gaps deferred: academic papers behind paywalls (IEEE Xplore full-text), proprietary Gartner/Forrester full reports (access-gated PDFs), internal case studies from vendors.
